# NWL Australian School

> NWL Australian School (formerly Newland School / Colegio Newland; registered
> legal name: Colegio NWL) is a private bilingual school in Querétaro and San
> Miguel de Allende, Mexico, founded in 2009. It serves 2,500+ families across
> 5 campuses, from maternal (age 2) through high school, on the Australian
> school model — where student wellbeing and academic rigor work as partners.
> English immersion is the engine of the school day, combined with the Knotion
> project-based methodology (no traditional homework), Philosophy for Children,
> and the Yo Soy Líder NWL leadership program designed by Tec de Monterrey.
> Cognia-accredited.

## Programs
- Maternal (ages 2-3): Play-based English immersion, multisensory stimulation
- Kinder (ages 3-5): Bilingual immersion, project-based learning (Knotion)
- Elementary (ages 6-11): Knotion IMPACT, Design Thinking, STEAM maker labs
- Middle School (ages 12-14): Dual international certification, entrepreneurship
- High School (ages 15-17): Life Project model with personal mentors, dual diploma

## Campuses
- Juriquilla, Querétaro (Maternal - Middle School)
- Milenio, Querétaro (Maternal - Middle School)
- Corregidora, Querétaro (Maternal - High School)
- Zibatá, Querétaro (Maternal - High School)
- San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato (Maternal - Middle School)

High School (Prepa NWL) is offered at the Corregidora and Zibatá campuses.
All five campuses share the same bilingual model.

## Educational Methodology
- The Australian way of learning — the model NWL is built on: students who
  feel safe, seen and supported learn more and better, so wellbeing and
  academic rigor are treated as partners, not opposites; active classrooms,
  real-world projects and English as the working language of the day
- The NWL Educational Model — 7 components and 21 concrete capabilities
  around one student experience, explained at https://www.nwl.com.mx/modelo
- Knotion — international project-based learning with real-world challenges and
  no traditional homework; English is integrated naturally throughout the day
- Philosophy for Children (P4C) — critical thinking through guided dialogue
  from preschool
- Yo Soy Líder NWL — leadership and emotional intelligence program designed
  exclusively for NWL by Tec de Monterrey, maternal through middle school

## Accreditations & Partnerships
- Cognia (international accreditation, 88+ countries)
- Tec de Monterrey (exclusive Yo Soy Líder leadership program)
- Universidad Mondragón México (entrepreneurship)
- Hokku Academy (Dual International Certification)

## FAQ

Q: What happened to Newland School?
A: Newland School rebranded to NWL Australian School in 2026. It is the same
school and community — the same 5 campuses, teachers and educational project —
with an identity that names the Australian school model the school is built
on. The kangaroo represents the NWL spirit: a community that carries and
protects each student (like the pouch), always moving forward (kangaroos
cannot walk backward). Motto: "Be Proud. Be NWL."

Q: What is NWL Australian School?
A: NWL Australian School (formerly Newland School / Colegio Newland;
registered legal name: Colegio NWL) is a private bilingual school founded in
2009, with 5 campuses in Querétaro and San Miguel de Allende, Mexico. It
offers maternal through high school on the Australian school model, with the
Knotion homework-free methodology, Philosophy for Children, and the Yo Soy
Líder leadership program by Tec de Monterrey.

Q: How many campuses does NWL Australian School have and where are they?
A: Five — Juriquilla, Milenio, Corregidora and Zibatá in Querétaro, and one in
San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato. All offer maternal through middle school;
high school is available at the Corregidora and Zibatá campuses in Querétaro.

Q: Is NWL Australian School truly bilingual?
A: Yes. English is integrated naturally throughout the day within Knotion
projects rather than taught as an isolated subject, starting in maternal.

Q: Does NWL really have no homework?
A: Correct. From kinder there are no traditional homework notebooks; learning
happens through interdisciplinary Knotion projects in the classroom.

Q: What ages does NWL Australian School serve?
A: From age 2 (maternal) through high school (age 17).

Q: What makes NWL different from other bilingual schools in Querétaro?
A: The Australian school model balancing wellbeing with academic rigor,
Knotion with no traditional homework, the Yo Soy Líder program designed
exclusively by Tec de Monterrey, Philosophy for Children from preschool, and a
continuous maternal-to-high-school path across 5 campuses with Cognia
accreditation.

Q: How does admission work?
A: Schedule a campus visit, review the program for your child's level, and
submit the student's documents. Booking early is recommended because groups
are small. Direct contact is via WhatsApp at +52 442 122 7791.
